name: Carbon Health Virtual Care
one_liner: Urgent and primary care by video or in clinic, with some mental health care (therapy in California, care-team support in primary care).
best_for: Adults who want quick video or same-day clinic visits for common issues, including starting care for anxiety or depression
People who want mental health support coordinated with their primary care
not_for: Anyone in crisis: call 911, or call or text 988
People who need a psychiatrist for complex conditions
People who want a dedicated, long-term therapy platform outside California
People outside Carbon Health's service states
short_description: Virtual and in-clinic urgent and primary care, with integrated mental health support; insurance or regional self-pay prices. Restructured in 2026 bankruptcy.
long_description: Carbon Health is a US urgent and primary care company with clinics and virtual visits through its app (now called Carby Health). It offers virtual urgent care, primary care, pediatrics and some mental health care: virtual therapy in California, and a collaborative-care model in which a mental health specialist works with your primary care team (self-pay flat $275 a month for bi-weekly sessions, per a May 2026 company post). Carbon Health and 28 affiliates filed for Chapter 11 in February 2026; the plan was confirmed on May 29, 2026 and took effect June 15, 2026, converting lender debt to ownership (led by Future Solution Investments) while clinics and virtual visits kept running. Some clinic sites were sold, and state coverage varies, so confirm availability for your state when booking. Self-pay prices vary by region. We found no published study of Carbon Health's mental health care.

pricing.starting_price: Copay with insurance; $149/session self-pay for new-patient virtual therapy (California)
pricing.notes: Self-pay prices vary by region and are shown when booking. Collaborative mental health care in primary care is a flat $275/month self-pay for bi-weekly specialist sessions (May 2026 company post). No membership fee.

privacy.notes: Medical records are covered by its HIPAA Notice of Privacy Practices (which says records can't be deleted because of retention rules); we could not confirm what the website privacy policy says about ad sharing, so the grade is unknown. Ownership changed in 2026.

seo.meta_description: Carbon Health provides virtual urgent care and primary care including mental health services, with same-day appointments and insurance accepted.

faqs.q: Does Carbon Health offer mental health services?
faqs.a: Yes, Carbon Health provides mental health evaluation and medication management through virtual and in-person visits. Clinicians can prescribe common anxiety and depression medications. For ongoing therapy, they can provide referrals.
Yes, Carbon Health accepts most major insurance plans. Check their website to verify your specific plan. They also offer transparent self-pay pricing for those without coverage.

faqs.q: How quickly can I see a provider?
faqs.a: Carbon Health offers same-day virtual appointments in most cases. For mental health concerns, you can typically see a provider within hours rather than waiting days or weeks like traditional practices.

faqs.q: Is Carbon Health good for mental health treatment?
faqs.a: Carbon Health works well for initial evaluation and medication for common conditions like anxiety and depression. For specialized psychiatric care, complex conditions, or ongoing therapy, a dedicated mental health platform may be more appropriate.

Collaborative mental health care with a primary care team

availability.note: Still operating after Chapter 11 (filed Feb 2026; plan effective June 15, 2026; now lender-owned). Clinics in some states; virtual care coverage varies by state, so check when booking.

patient_summary: You book a video or clinic visit in the Carby Health app or on carbonhealth.com for urgent or primary care, where a clinician can treat common issues such as anxiety or depression and refer you on. Carbon Health takes most major insurance; self-pay prices vary by region and show when you book (virtual therapy in California is $149 for a new patient). The company went through Chapter 11 bankruptcy in 2026 and kept operating under new lender ownership.
